name: FOX'S WEAPON SOUND MOD updated
teaser: Do you hate the default unsuppressed m4a1 sound? Yeah me too. Enjoy mw2019 sounds then! works with 3.8.0
description_html:
Full description and OG mod can be found here.

Do you hate the default unsuppressed m4a1 sound? do you love mw2019 gun sounds? you’ve come to the right place mah dude.

This mod replaces that awful sounding unsuppressed m4a1 sound into mw2019 m4a1 sound so you can, my fellow unsuppressed m4a1 enjoyer, enjoy the gunfight asmr. Also replaces other weapon sounds in-game, just check the OG mod link above.

Special shoutout to BooMoon for the fix since this mod previously breaks mp-153 and glock into weird animation. Tested with 3.8.0 and after playing for an hour or two, I haven’t encountered any issues whatsoever.

Full credits goes to Fox. I’m just someone who enabled mod compatibility with 3.8.0.
